subject: Level 0
text: Level 0 is an endless maze of damp yellow carpet and humming fluorescent lights, its halls shifting whenever no one looks.
author: DivineAtlas, DrAkimoto, and RobertGoerman

subject: Level 0.2
text: Level 0.2 is a freshly remodeled copy of Level 0 that looks tidy and welcoming until it begins to collapse around visitors.
author: RowanLater

subject: Level 1
text: Level 1 is a vast concrete warehouse where supply crates appear from nowhere and something stirs whenever the lights flicker out.
author: Praetor3005 and DivineAtlas

subject: Level 2
text: Level 2 is a maze of cramped utility tunnels strung with pipes and wiring, every corridor turning at exactly forty-five degrees.
author: Greggita Mahayfaio

subject: Level 3
text: Level 3 is a dim, buzzing electrical station rich in rare resources, though indestructible bars seal off most of its halls.
author: Natedagreat563

subject: Level 4
text: Level 4 is an empty office building with blacked-out windows; quiet and well supplied, it is where wanderers meet.
author: u/M654zy

subject: Level 5
text: Level 5 is an endless 1930s hotel that cleans itself, with soft jazz in the halls and party chatter behind the walls.
author: Stretchsterz

subject: Level 6
text: Level 6 is a web of narrow concrete halls in total darkness and silence, where no light source will work.
author: Bart0nius

subject: Level 6.1
text: Level 6.1 is an endless mall food court of snack bars from every era, whose exits keep opening into another restaurant.
author: Stretchsterz

subject: Level 7
text: Level 7 is a dimly lit ocean that stretches forever beneath a high concrete ceiling, its depths almost unexplored.
author: Bart0nius

subject: Level 8
text: Level 8 is a vast system of wild caves where time wears everything out too fast, from food and lamps to signposts.
author: C-Graph and kai4C

subject: Level 9
text: Level 9 is an endless suburb stuck at midnight, its furnished houses dark and powerless, some of them strangely identical.
author: Stretchsterz

subject: Level 10
text: Level 10 is a boundless farmland of wheat and barley under a leaden sky, where only the wind marks the passing time.
author: scutoid studios and egglord

subject: Level 11
text: Level 11 is an empty, endless city of streets and skyscrapers that serves as the unofficial crossroads of the Backrooms.
author: Greggita Mahayfaio, inspired by the original Level 11 by nerdykiddo4884

subject: Level 26
text: Level 26 is the SS Fun, a cruise ship claimed by the Partygoers, its lower decks sinking into endless party rooms.
author: Robert Goerman and MC_Crafter_24_7

subject: Level 37
text: Level 37 is a senseless complex of spotless white-tiled rooms flooded with lukewarm water, far too vast to be a pool.
author: egglord

subject: Level 94
text: Level 94 is a grainy stop-motion town from the 1930s, cheerful by day until night falls and the Animations come out.
author: Stretchsterz, Dr. Bierre and ShadowOfTheProphet

subject: Level 188
text: Level 188 is a chilly white courtyard ringed by evenly spaced windows, many of them hungry entities behind drawn blinds.
author: Kai4C

subject: Level 283
text: Level 283 is a colossal indoor playground of winding tubes, padded halls, play castles and ball pits with no apparent bottom.
author: korbenmart

subject: Level 974
text: Level 974 is a small pink house with no door to the outside, subtly tailored to each visitor who arrives carrying something cute.
author: AndromedeadReal

subject: Level 999
text: Level 999 is a tropical island floating in a starry void, where a strange aura drains every colour to grey.
author: Greggita Mahayfaio

subject: Bursters
text: Bursters are crawling creatures that rest curled up on Level 3 until something living comes near and their blisters burst.
author: Kekcroc

subject: Clump
text: Clumps are tangled bundles of limbs that hide in spaces far too tight for them and move with startling speed.
author: Kekcroc, rewritten by TrailmixNCocoa

subject: Deathmoths
text: Deathmoths are chimeric moths built from many insect species, living in castes and reshaping their bodies over generations.
author: DrAkimoto

subject: Dullers
text: Dullers are faceless grey humanoids that flee when approached, yet hunt by reaching an arm through a wall.
author: Anonymous Fandom/Reddit user, rewritten by Stretchsterz

subject: Dunks
text: Dunks are small boxy creatures with a trunk shaped like a human arm, easily tamed and obedient to a fault.
author: BearPig

subject: Facelings
text: Facelings are faceless humanoids that imitate human lives and routines without quite understanding them.
author: Jo and Higher Being Love Cereal!, rewritten by 1000dumplings and Nikuchan

subject: Hound
text: Hounds are humanoids that run on all fours like dogs, attack on sight, and back off briefly when stared down.
author: Palico 22, rewritten by 1000dumplings

subject: Jerry
text: Jerry is a talking blue parrot whose legend grows with each retelling, able to turn those who meet it into devotees.
author: Sariastuff

subject: Partygoers
text: Partygoers are tall yellow figures with a carved smiley face, forever inviting wanderers to a party best never attended.
author: Robert Goerman and MC_Crafter_24_7

subject: Skin-Stealer
text: Skin-Stealers are large humanoids that disguise themselves as the people they prey on and imitate human speech.
author: AndromedaMapping1, rewritten by 1000dumplings

subject: Smilers
text: Smilers lurk in the dark as gleaming eyes and teeth; they chase light and panic, and holding their gaze keeps them back.
author: Palico22, rewritten by Stretchsterz

subject: The Hub
text: The Hub is a hidden network of orange-lit road tunnels holding a doorway to every level of the Backrooms.
author: Mctoran and Stretchsterz

subject: The Manila Room
text: The Manila Room is a small beige room hidden in Level 0, where notes on a table teach newcomers how to escape.
author: Br Miller and Neptunium

subject: The Windows
text: The Windows are predatory entities posing as ordinary windows, whispering comfort to passers-by and fading without new victims.
author: DrAkimoto

subject: Transporters
text: Transporters are floating silhouettes that seize wanderers by the hands and pull them through a wall to some random level.
author: Anonymous Fandom/Reddit user, rewritten by stellate

subject: Warning Kites
text: Warning Kites are childlike kites that appear when danger nears, flying away from it to show wanderers where not to go.
author: s n o w y

subject: Wretches
text: Wretches were once human, worn into zombielike husks by hunger, thirst and sleeplessness, lingering wherever people gather.
author: Stretchsterz and etoisle
